The main takeaway from our work is that
the isotope coefficient is a material dependent quantity and that the observed large isotope effect cannot be explained by a simple electron-phonon mechanism.
the large isotope coefficient is not due to the substitution of the Co atoms, which is the case for other quasi one-dimensional superconductors, but due to the substitution in the carbon sublattice.
